# Project scope

## Purpose

{{name}} is a small sandbox command line app that reads a JSON file, calls a function of the library `{{other}}` and prints the result. It exists to test the Repo Concierge and is not used for anything else.

## In scope

- Commands that read a file, call the library and print the result
- Fixes for wrong, missing or surprising output, arguments and error messages
- Tests and documentation for them

## Out of scope

- A web page, a dashboard or any other graphical interface. The app is a command line program.
- Storing results in a database or sending them to a network service.

## Where to go instead

- A new way of computing a result belongs in `{{other}}`.
